summary.text: Jay Dean is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 7 who has represented the district since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jay Dean took office in the Texas House in 2017.
Ballotpedia lists his 2023-2024 committee assignments as Environmental Regulation and House State Affairs.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.
